articles.summary: Acquisition expands scale and strengthens industry leading valuation platform Stewart Valuation Intelligence (SVI), a Stewart Information Services Corporation company (NYSE: STC), announced today that it has acquired Nationwide Appraisal Network, LLC (NAN), a nationally recognized appraisal management company with more than two decades of leading and shaping the appraisal industry. “The addition of NAN strengthens SVI by expanding our appraisal scale and deepening our talent base,” said Fred Eppinger, Stewart CEO. “NAN shares our commitment to service excellence, quality, and strong client relationships, and this transaction reinforces our investment in valuation services within our Real Estate Solutions segment.
